attacks.name: Wall-Shattering Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Stun|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stun§Stun| special condition.

attacks.name: Emerald Objection!
steps: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |*Stagger|: After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Approach the Bench!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Cross Examine
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is within |!range| 3, roll 4 dice. Deal 1 |!damage| to the attacker for each |!critical| and each |!wild| rolled. If the attacker has already targeted this character with an attack this Turn, roll 6 dice instead of 4.

superPowers.name: Case Prep
superPowers.body: When attacking, if this character rolled no |!hit| results, it may reroll all of its attack dice. When defending, if this character rolled no |!block| results, it may reroll all of its defense dice.

superPowers.name: Gamma Powered
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
